description: This Kotlin source file contains utility functions for handling scrollbars in a Lazy layout within a Jetpack Compose-based Android application. It provides functions to interpolate item indices for smooth scrollbar behavior and to compute the visibility percentage of individual items within the viewport.

methods.name: interpolateFirstItemIndex
methods.description: Calculates a smooth interpolated index for the first visible item in a lazy list based on current scroll offset and neighboring items, aiding in scrollbar thumb position calculations.

methods.name: itemVisibilityPercentage
methods.description: Computes the visible portion of an item within the viewport as a percentage, useful for partial visibility calculations.
